attempts.why: The .btn rule (display:inline-flex) appears after .menu-toggle and overrides its display:none, so the mobile menu toggle is incorrectly visible at 1200px; increasing specificity restores the intended hidden state on desktop.

selfVerify.reason: At 1200px viewport the hamburger/menu-toggle is not visible in header (only desktop nav and Get started shown), so display:none is now correctly applied with no obvious regression.
